notes.title: Block Buster Hot Fix Patch
notes.content:
Hot Fix update:

Mt. Sakura fixes: 
-	Kai tech scientists in the Mt. Sakura secret zone will now run away when you enter the zone. 
-	Helicopters now fly and follow the player more accurately without colliding with level obstacles.

Park Central fixes:
-	The biplanes in the boss level no longer disappear when you grab them.
-	Humans can be skipped across the water in the park.

Mega Block Fixes:
-	The secret zone entrance is was blocked. It is now fixed.
-	Drones no longer fly into the tower and do a better job attacking players.

General Fixes:
-	We’ve updated the auto aim to be more precise. Now you can look directly at a target and it will lock on.

Thank you again for your continued support!
